# 微梦大梁门

2019年打造的《古马道》和《微梦大梁门》两场沉浸式裸眼 3D演出，以文化+科技的手段再现了北宋东京城千年前的盛世繁华，带您体验攻城、炮火、箭雨、水患下所孕育的开封城摞城、墙摞墙、马道摞马道的文化奇观。景区通过对夜游产品的开发，丰富了文化内涵，全新的文化理念，延伸和丰富了城墙文化经济产业系统，真正做到“让文物活起来，让遗产靓起来”成为古都开封新的靓丽风景线。

The two immersive naked eye 3D performances of "Ancient Horse Road" and "Micro Dream Big Beam Gate", created in 2019, use cultural and technological means to reproduce the prosperous era of Tokyo City in the Northern Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, taking you to experience the cultural wonders of Kaifeng City Stacking City, Wall Stacking Wall, Horse Path Stacking Horse Path nurtured by siege, artillery fire, arrow rain, and floods. Through the development of night tourism products, the scenic area has enriched cultural connotations, new cultural concepts, extended and enriched the cultural and economic industry system of the city wall, truly achieving the goal of "bringing cultural relics to life and beautifying heritage" and becoming a new beautiful scenic line in the ancient capital of Kaifeng.
